| Use 1 Force to attempt to eliminate a starfighter's permanent pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; 2, deploy on starfighter to remove permanent pilot. May now add 1 pilot. == Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Come With Me]]. Columns cover distinct published text states in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata and every Players Committee errata image; the stamp row describes the displayed rendition. Revised, Japanese, foil, and Virtual printings remain in Versions. Yellow highlights mark changed words against the column before.
